narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The kite is a square, so the shadow is still a square.
<bookmark mark='compare'/>A square has two diagonals of the same length.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Here one is ten and the other is six, so it cannot be a square.

<bookmark mark='two'/>Half of each diagonal gives a right triangle for the side.
<bookmark mark='turn'/>Your turn. A square has diagonals of eight centimetres. One shadow diagonal is six. How long is each side?
